newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Water considers acquisition offer. [CORRECTED 19:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Southwest Water considers acquisition offer. [CORRECTED 19:55 GMT]

text.p: Southwest Water Co on Friday said it has been approached by Albuquerque, New Mexico about selling Southwest Water's New Mexico Utilities Inc. (Corrects to show Southwest Water, not the city, owns New Mexico Utilities).
Formal talks about a proposed acquisition will begin within the next 30 days, Southwest Water said in a statement.
It declined to predict whether a final acquisition deal could be reached or at what price it could occur.
New Mexico Utility operates in the northwest portion of the city and surrounding county, and it serves about 5,000 customers.
